manifest.name: dsh-ai-session-title
manifest.description: AI-generated session titles for DeepSeek Harness: one-click generation inside the session rename dialog.
manifest.author: MaouXY <nax666@qq.com>

scripts.test: node test/host.smoke.mjs && node test/client.locale.mjs && node test/client.render.mjs

readme.text:
为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**会话重命名对话框**加一个 AI 生成按钮：读取真实对话内容（以及你已经输入的草稿），让当前会话所用的模型写一个短标题，填进输入框——你确认后按「重命名」，不满意就继续改。

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ai-session-title)
[](LICENSE)

要求：**dsh ≥ 0.2.1-rc.3**、**Node ≥ 20**。

- 打开任意会话自带的「重命名会话」对话框（侧栏 `···` → 重命名会话）。
- 输入框内**右侧**、同一条边框里多一个星标按钮——不是新弹窗，就是原生那个框。
- 点一下：读取该会话的对话记录，连同你已输入的草稿一起作为参考，生成标题并填回输入框。
- 底部仍然是原生的「取消 / 重命名」；生成不会自己改名，必须你点确认。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-ai-session-title
```

然后重启 `dsh web` 并刷新页面。

> 自带 `dsh` 的桌面版请在 App 内 **设置 → 插件** 里安装，不要用命令行——App 运行期间不会让 CLI 改写它自己的 profile。

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target = <本目录的绝对路径>
```

或者让 agent 用 `plugin_manager` 工具装。装完刷新 Web 界面。
市场读取的是 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 这份目录，而不是本仓库。目录收录之后，在 **插件 → 发现** 里搜索安装即可。

一个包，两半：

| 半边 | 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `index.js` | 注册全局命令 `/ai-title`。读会话事件日志、按下一次请求要用的路由（`session.requestHeader().config`，取不到时回退到最新一条助手消息）选模型，用 `ctx.llm` 以 `purpose: 'session-title'` 流式生成一条，清洗后返回。命令名后面的文本视为用户的草稿标题。 |
| Client | `client.js` | 监听原生对话框的会话名输入框，就地装饰一个星标按钮；点击后调用 `ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, '/ai-title <草稿>', [])`，把返回的标题用原生 `input` 事件写回该输入框。 |

两个实现细节值得说明：

- **为什么装饰 DOM 而不是注册插槽**：原生对话框把目标会话存在组件内部 state 里，通过 `shell.overlay` 渲染，内部没有暴露任何插槽，所以插件拿不到插入点，只能就地装饰它；会话 id 则通过输入框预填的标题在 Workspace Service 的会话列表里反查。
- **为什么走命令**：客户端到 host 的 RPC 接口是构建期生成的，第三方 bundle 无法新增方法，命令是唯一稳定的调用通道。代价是每次生成会在会话流里留下一条 `command/run` + `command/done` 记录——这也是生成过程中唯一的可见反馈。

装好之后打开 **更多 → 设置**，左侧导航里会多出一项 **「AI 会话标题」**，改完点保存即可：

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `style` | 标题结构，决定生成出来的标题长什么样，见下表 |
| `datePrefix` | 是否在标题前加「月-日」前缀，默认关 |
| `prompt` | 自定义结构提示词，只在 `style` 选“自定义”时生效；留空按“主题”处理 |
| `maxTitleChars` | 标题字符上限，默认 `30` |

四种结构对应四种“以后怎么把会话找回来”的方式：

| `style` | 名称 | 示例 | 适合 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `concise` | 主题 | `登录超时排查` | 默认。3~8 字名词短语，侧栏最窄时也能一眼扫过去 |
| `descriptive` | 动作 | `重构登录状态管理` | 动词开头，回看时知道这次做了什么 |
| `outcome` | 主题 + 结论 | `分页错位 · 定位到索引边界` | 先主题再产出，复盘时最能看出这次值不值 |
| `custom` | 自定义 | 由提示词决定 | 用 `prompt` 描述你自己想要的格式 |

日期单独是一个开关，不是第五种结构：打开 `datePrefix`，上面任何一种结构都会多出 `10-30 ` 前缀，所以「日期 + 主题」「日期 + 主题 + 结论」都是两次点击的事，不用为每种组合再列一张卡片。

`datePrefix` 的日期不是模型编的：插件读会话第一条消息的时间，自己补 `MM-DD `，并且先从前缀里扣掉 6 个字符再要求模型写正文，所以总长度仍然守得住 `maxTitleChars`。

不管选哪种结构，硬性要求都不变：只输出一行纯文本，不加引号、前缀或 Markdown，语言跟随对话。结构只换措辞，不会把生成结果弄脏。

早先版本里的 `english` / `dated` 两个结构值仍然被接受：`english` 照旧输出英文标题，`dated` 等价于「主题 + 打开 `datePrefix`」，所以旧配置升级后不会挂。

这一页由插件自己注册（`settings.section`），读写的就是插件自己的配置项 `ai-session-title`，和下面手写 `cordis.patch.yml` 完全等价。

少数高级项不放在设置页里，需要时写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: ai-session-title
  name: dsh-ai-session-title
  config:
    provider: deepseek

| 键 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `provider` / `model` | 强制指定路由。要么都配、要么都不配；默认按下一次请求的路由，取不到再用最新一条助手消息的路由。 |
| `timeoutMs` | 生成超时，默认 `60000`。 |
| `maxOutputTokens` | 单次调用的输出预算，默认 `1024`。思考型模型如果先思考、把预算耗光才轮到你看到的标题，会报 `max-tokens`，把它调大即可。 |

`engines.dsh` 声明为 `^0.2.1-rc.3`。DSH 只按 `engines.dsh` 判断兼容性（没有该字段时才回退到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 范围），插件市场的卡片上也会显示这个要求。

这个插件在运行时只导入一个 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包：host 半边用 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 声明 `Config`（harness 自带），其余只用 `ctx.commands` / `ctx.llm`；client 半边只用 `ctx.remote` 和 DOM API。好处是任何 profile 都不需要额外装依赖就能加载；代价是如果上游改了这些服务的签名或重命名对话框的结构，就需要跟着发新版本。

```sh
npm test        # host 半边的冒烟测试，不需要 harness、也不需要模型
```

client 半边没有构建步骤：`client.js` 按原样被加载。改完刷新 Web 界面即可（profile 里是 `link:` 安装，不用重装）。

```text
cordis.patch.yml     把行 id `ai-session-title` 插入为本包
index.js             host 半边（命令 + 生成）
client.js            client 半边（就地装饰 + 远程调用）
test/host.smoke.mjs  host 半边冒烟测试（npm test）

**按钮没出现？** 确认插件已启用、刷新过页面，且 dsh 版本满足 `^0.2.1-rc.3`。

**报「模型没有返回可用的标题」？** 多数是思考型模型把输出预算全用在推理上，调大 `maxOutputTokens`。

**报「无法确定要命名的会话」？** 说明输入框里的标题在会话列表里匹配不到（例如同名的会话刚被改名）。先在侧栏打开该会话再试一次。
MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

Adds an **AI generate** control inside the session rename dialog of DeepSeek
Harness (DSH). It asks the session's current model for a short title derived
from the real conversation — plus whatever draft you already typed — and fills
it into the name field. You review it and press 重命名, or keep your own text.

English | [中文](README.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ai-session-title)
[](LICENSE)

Requires **dsh ≥ 0.2.1-rc.3** and **Node ≥ 20**.

- Open the built-in rename dialog of any session (`···` → 重命名会话).
- A sparkle button appears at the trailing edge **inside** the name field, on
  the same border — it is the shipped dialog, not a replacement.
- Clicking it reads that session's transcript (plus the current field text as a
  reference draft), generates a title, and writes it back into the field.
- The native 取消 / 重命名 footer is unchanged; generation never renames on its
  own, you still confirm.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add dsh-ai-session-title
```

Then restart `dsh web` and reload the page.

> Desktop builds that bundle their own `dsh` should install from the app's
> **Settings → Plugins**; the CLI never rewrites the app-owned profile while the
> app is running.

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target = <absolute path to this directory>
```

or let an agent do it with the `plugin_manager` tool, then reload the Web UI.

The market reads the
[awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
catalog, not this repository. Once an entry exists there, install it from
**Plugins → Discover**.

| Half | File | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `index.js` | Registers the global `/ai-title` command. It reads the session's event log, picks the route the next request would use (`session.requestHeader().config`, else the newest assistant message), streams one completion through `ctx.llm` with `purpose: 'session-title'`, and returns a cleaned title. Text after the command name is treated as the user's draft title. |
| Client | `client.js` | Watches for the shipped dialog's name field and decorates it in place, then calls `ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, '/ai-title <draft>', [])` and writes the returned text into the field through a native `input` event. |

- **Why decorate the DOM instead of registering a slot**: the shipped dialog
  keeps its target session in component state and renders through
  `shell.overlay`, exposing no slot inside itself, so there is no insertion
  point for a plugin. The session id is recovered by matching the field's seeded
  title against the Workspace Service's session list.
- **Why a command**: the client→host RPC surface is generated at build time and
  cannot be extended by third-party bundles, so a command is the only stable
  channel. The cost is a small `command/run` + `command/done` pair per
  generation in the session flow — also the only visible feedback while it runs.

Once installed, open **More → Settings**: the navigation gains an **"AI session
title"** section. Edit it and save there:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `style` | Title structure — what the generated title looks like; see the table below |
| `datePrefix` | Put an `MM-DD ` prefix in front of the title, off by default |
| `prompt` | Custom structure instruction, used only when `style` is `custom`; left empty it behaves like `concise` |
| `maxTitleChars` | Hard character cap on the returned title, default `30` |

The four presets are four ways of finding a session again later:

| `style` | Name | Sample | Use it when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `concise` | Subject | `Login timeout` | Default. A 3~8 character noun phrase that survives the narrowest sidebar row |
| `descriptive` | Action | `Refactor login state` | Starts with a verb, so the row says what you did |
| `outcome` | Subject + outcome | `Paging off-by-one · fixed` | Subject first, then what came out of it — the most useful when reviewing work |
| `custom` | Custom | decided by the prompt | Describe your own shape in `prompt` |

The day is a switch, not a fifth preset: with `datePrefix` on, every structure
above gains a `10-30 ` prefix, so "date + subject" and "date + subject +
outcome" are one click apart instead of two more cards.

That prefix is not written by the model: the plugin formats it from the first
message's timestamp and reserves those six characters out of the cap before
asking for the body, so the total still honours `maxTitleChars`.

Whichever structure is picked, the hard rules stay: one line of plain text, no
quotes, label, or Markdown, in the language of the conversation. A preset only
changes the wording, so a custom prompt cannot corrupt what the command result
carries.

The retired `english` and `dated` values are still accepted: `english` keeps
producing English titles, and `dated` means "concise plus the date prefix", so an
older configuration keeps working after the upgrade.

That page is registered by the plugin itself (`settings.section`) and edits the
plugin's own `ai-session-title` entry, so it is exactly equivalent to writing the
`cordis.patch.yml` block below by hand.

A few advanced keys are kept off the settings page; write them into the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml` when needed:

```yaml
- id: ai-session-title
  name: dsh-ai-session-title
  config:
    provider: deepseek

| Key | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `provider`, `model` | Force a route. Both or neither; defaults to the route the next request would use, then the newest assistant message. |
| `timeoutMs` | Generation deadline, default `60000`. |
| `maxOutputTokens` | Output budget for the one call, default `1024`. Raise it when a reasoning model spends the budget thinking and answers with nothing visible (`max-tokens`). |

`engines.dsh` is `^0.2.1-rc.3`. DSH decides compatibility from `engines.dsh`
alone (falling back to lockstep `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer ranges when it is
absent), and the market shows that requirement on the plugin card.

The plugin imports exactly one `@deepseek-ai/*` package at runtime:
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, which the host half uses to declare `Config` (the
harness ships it). Beyond that the host half uses only `ctx.commands` /
`ctx.llm`, and the client half only `ctx.remote` and DOM APIs. That keeps it loadable from any profile without a
dependency install, but it also means a harness that renames those services or
changes the rename dialog's markup needs a matching plugin release.

```sh
npm test        # host-half smoke test — no harness, no model
```

The client half has no build step: `client.js` is served as written. Edit it and
reload the Web UI (the profile installs this package as a `link:`, so no
reinstall is needed).

```text
cordis.patch.yml     inserts row id `ai-session-title` as this package
index.js             host half (command + generation)
client.js            client half (in-place decoration + remote calls)
test/host.smoke.mjs  host-half smoke test (npm test)

**The button is missing.** Check that the plugin is enabled, that you reloaded
the page, and that your dsh satisfies `^0.2.1-rc.3`.

**"the model did not return a usable title".** Usually a reasoning model
spending the whole output budget on reasoning — raise `maxOutputTokens`.

**"cannot determine which session to name".** The field's title matched no
session in the list (for example a same-titled session was just renamed). Open
that session in the sidebar first, then retry.
